items.summary: Spyware implants in Ledger wallets have surfaced across Asia and Europe, raising supply-chain concerns after more than $86M in suspected thefts

items.title: Blur to Shut Down NFT Marketplace After Blast
items.summary: Blur will shut down its website and halt new NFT loans on November 12, just ten days after sister project Blast announced its closure.
